decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line bug-fix title, "scheduling flake due to nodepool readiness (#6491)" [ev-518a56c0e2c1]. It doesn't say whether the flake happened in running Karpenter scheduling or only in tests, and it doesn't describe any effect on an operator. Nearby items such as "scheduling zone-id flake" [ev-f21609ff075e] and "add required startup taint to NodeClaim E2E test" [ev-aa6e55e47c2f] suggest it could be a test-only fix, which would make the consequence "none" rather than behavior-change. Settling the consequence needs PR #6491's description or diff showing whether runtime scheduling behaviour changed.
